articles.title: Probly Announces Its Prediction-Market Integration With TxFlow L1
articles.description:
NEW YORK, July 20, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Probly
, an onchain prediction market application built around real-time events and changing expectations, today announced its deployment on TxFlow L1
 through TxFlow Improvement Protocol 3, known as TIP3.
